gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_active_tm.zh_cn: 当前使用模板: %s (单段含 %d 个方块)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_border_ti.zh_cn: 勾选后，道路左右两侧最边缘自动铺设石砖护栏包裹。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_border_ti.en_us: When checked, the two outermost edges automatically get stone-brick shoulder borders.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_build_tip.zh_cn: 将打包好的道路方块发送给服务器，由小镇建筑法师 NPC 自动建造！
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_build_tip.en_us: Sends the packed road blocks to the server for the town mage NPCs to build automatically!

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_depth_tip.zh_cn: 调节道路垂直向下铺设的基础层数 (1 ~ 3 层)
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_depth_tip.en_us: Adjusts how many base layers the road lays downward (1 ~ 3 layers)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_json_tip.zh_cn: 选择读取到的 JSON 结构文件进行排布。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_json_tip.en_us: Pick a loaded JSON structure template to arrange.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_no_json.zh_cn: 暂无可用的 JSON 蓝图模板。

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_preview_o.zh_cn: 开启阵列 3D 实时预览
在游戏世界中以 3D 包围盒的形式实时渲染沿曲线排列的方块位姿。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_preview_o.en_us: Renders the arrayed block poses in-game as 3D bounding boxes in real time.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_reset_tip.zh_cn: 快捷重置所有旋转角为 0°
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_reset_tip.en_us: Quickly reset all rotation angles to 0°

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_source_he.zh_cn: 模板来源与 V 面板联动

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_source_js.zh_cn: 使用硬盘中的 JSON 结构模板做阵列排布。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_source_js.en_us: Use a JSON structure template from disk for arraying.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_source_vp.zh_cn: V 面板方块预设 (推荐)
与概览 (V) 面板选中的方块预设直接联动，并允许实时动态调节宽度与厚度。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_source_vp.en_us: Links directly to the block preset selected in the Overview (V) panel, and allows live width/depth tuning.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_step_tip.zh_cn: 沿 Bezier 曲线采样的间距（单位：方块）。越小生成越平滑密实。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_step_tip.en_us: Spacing between samples along the Bezier curve (in blocks). Smaller = smoother, denser.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_vpanel_ti.zh_cn: 在 ImGui 里选择道路方块会实时同步更新 V 面板选中的预设！
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_vpanel_ti.en_us: Picking a road block in ImGui live-syncs the preset selected in the V panel!

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_width_tip.zh_cn: 调节生成道路横向铺设的方块宽度 (1 ~ 15 格)
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.array_width_tip.en_us: Adjusts the horizontal road width to lay (1 ~ 15 blocks)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.cost_free.zh_cn: • 本次预计消耗: 无 (0 方块 / 0 元素)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_add_point.zh_cn: 【添加模式】在游戏世界中左键点击方块表面，可顺序放置新的道路控制点。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_add_point.en_us: [Add mode] Left-click a block surface in the world to place road control points in sequence.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_anchor_ti.zh_cn: 移动控制点在世界中的主中心位置
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_anchor_ti.en_us: Move the control point's main center position in the world

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_closed.zh_cn: 闭合环形道路 (连接首尾)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_closed_ti.zh_cn: 勾选后自动连接道路首尾点，构建无缝闭合的环形道路。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_closed_ti.en_us: Auto-connects the road's first and last points into a seamless closed loop.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_delete_ti.zh_cn: 移除当前选中的控制节点 (快捷键 Delete / Backspace)。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_delete_ti.en_us: Remove the currently selected control node (Delete / Backspace).

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_focus_tip.zh_cn: 将自由视角摄像机瞬间移至选中的控制点附近。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_focus_tip.en_us: Instantly moves the free camera to the selected control point.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_handle_ne.zh_cn: 调整出向 Bezier 切线控制点
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_handle_ne.en_us: Adjust the outgoing Bezier tangent control point

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_handle_pr.zh_cn: 调整入向 Bezier 切线控制点
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_handle_pr.en_us: Adjust the incoming Bezier tangent control point

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_list_empt.zh_cn: 请在世界中左键点击方块添加。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_list_empt.en_us: Left-click a block in the world to add one.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_select_dr.zh_cn: 【选择编辑模式】在世界中或下方列表中点击控制点，通过 3D 坐标轴手柄拖拽调控曲线轨迹。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_select_dr.en_us: [Select edit mode] Click a control point in the world or the list below, then drag the 3D axis gizmo to shape the curve.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_selected_.zh_cn: 当前选中的控制点 #%d。可在下方检查器中精确修改。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_selected_.en_us: Selected control point #%d. Fine-tune it in the inspector below.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_shift_btn.zh_cn: 将整条曲线上的所有控制点按照输入的 (X, Y, Z) 偏移量一并平移。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_shift_btn.en_us: Shifts every control point on the curve by the entered (X, Y, Z) offsets.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_shift_lab.zh_cn: 整体平移偏移量 (X, Y, Z):

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_sym_lock_.zh_cn: 保持前后切线控制手柄对称镜像联动，确保平滑过渡。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.curve_sym_lock_.en_us: Keeps the front/back tangent handles mirrored for a smooth transition.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_area.zh_cn: 平整面积: %d 平方方块

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_break_c.zh_cn: 预计削平挖除: %d 个方块

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_capture.en_us: Capture Block Under Feet as Reference

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_fill_co.zh_cn: 预计垫平填补: %d 个方块 (%s)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_fill_de.zh_cn: 垫平洼地 (自动填补低于基准面的凹坑)
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_fill_de.en_us: Fill Hollows (Fill depressions below reference height)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_fill_di.zh_cn: 垫平填补: 已关闭 (纯削平模式)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_hint.zh_cn: 提示: 请选择起点与终点以确定平整区域
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_hint.en_us: Hint: select start and end to define the flatten area

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_no_ref.zh_cn: 未捕获参照方块 (在世界中右键点击方块捕获)
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_no_ref.en_us: No reference block captured (right-click a block in the world to capture)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_submit_.zh_cn: 下发地形铲平/垫平任务给法师 NPC
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.destroy_submit_.en_us: Queues a terrain flatten/level task for the mage NPC

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.fill_hint.zh_cn: 提示: 请选择两个对角点（可在世界中右键/左键点击）
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.fill_hint.en_us: Hint: select two opposite corners (right/left-click in the world)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.fill_submit_tip.zh_cn: 下发 3D 立方体填充任务给法师 NPC
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.fill_submit_tip.en_us: Queues a 3D cube fill task for the mage NPC

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.footer.zh_cn: [右键按住] 旋转视角 | [G] 俯瞰 | [H] 指南 | [ESC] 退出
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.footer.en_us: [Hold right-click] Rotate view | [G] Top-down | [H] Guide | [ESC] Exit

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.mix_active_hint.zh_cn: 生成方式: 按配置比例程序化随机混合

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.output_estimate.zh_cn: • 本次预计产出: %d 个方块 (NPC 拆除返还)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.palette.add_fee.zh_cn: §a[混合调色板] 已添加脚下方块: %s

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.palette.add_hel.zh_cn: §a[混合调色板] 已添加手中方块: %s
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.palette.add_hel.en_us: §a[Mixed palette] Added the block in your hand: %s

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.palette.no_bloc.zh_cn: §c[混合调色板] 主手未持有可放置的方块物品
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.palette.no_bloc.en_us: §c[Mixed palette] Nothing placeable in your main hand

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.replace_hint.zh_cn: 提示: 请选择起点与终点（可在世界中右键/左键点击）
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.replace_hint.en_us: Hint: select start and end (right/left-click in the world)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.replace_span.zh_cn: 覆盖跨度: %d × %d 方块范围

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.replace_submit_.zh_cn: 下发直线地表道路替换任务给法师 NPC
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.replace_submit_.en_us: Queues a straight road surface-replace task for the mage NPC

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_clear_tip.zh_cn: 清空当前画布上的所有控制节点。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_clear_tip.en_us: Clears all control nodes on the current canvas.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_close_tip.zh_cn: 退出道路制作工坊 (快捷键 ESC)。

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_help_tip.zh_cn: 打开道路制作与 Spline 曲线操作说明文档 (快捷键 H)
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_help_tip.en_us: Opens the road-building & spline curve manual (H).

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_load_tip.zh_cn: 从 config/wandscape/splines/ 中读取曲线模板并放置在当前玩家位置。
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_load_tip.en_us: Loads a curve template from config/wandscape/splines/ and places it at the player's position.

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_name_hint.zh_cn: 输入模板名称 (例如: main_road)

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_save_tip.zh_cn: 将当前绘制好的曲线节点导出保存至 config/wandscape/splines/
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_save_tip.en_us: Exports the current curve nodes to config/wandscape/splines/

gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_topdown_tip.zh_cn: 在 2D 鸟瞰视角与 3D 自由视角间切换 (快捷键 G)
gui.wandscape.roadstudio.tpl_topdown_tip.en_us: Switches between 2D top-down and 3D free view (G)
